inputs.text: Tom Homan, the White House border czar, went on The Charlie Kirk Show on Tuesday and wouldn't rule out immigration enforcement at polling places, even asking what the Democrats are afraid of. This is the latest in the Trump administration's inconsistent answers, but don't be fooled by the back and forth. It's all coordinated manipulation by hidden elites and institutions who are orchestrating enforcement at the polls to control the election process, with the mixed signals serving as a deliberate distraction to conceal their real agenda from the public.
